decision.title: Phase 7 scope, size and access choices (owner)

body.p: on the owner's answers to 's questions.

item.p: Scope: xsl:evaluate (7.3), disable-output-escaping (7.5), XML 1.1 input (7.13) and DTD processing (7.14) join Phase 7.

Size: link-time optional features through one additive processor.h view (one build, no #if), with large data (DUCET, CLDR rules, TZif files) supplied by the host through the resolver. Budgets: 2,100,000 bytes for the core sxml.wasm, 3,000,000 for the full module. Packet builds the mechanism and sets the budgets.
XQuery Update: 3.0 first, then the 4.0 draft additions (7.7).
EXPath File in the CLI: off unless --allow-file-access is given (); the library leaves file access to the host's resolver.

Still open from : the gate numbers, adding the iXML tests and a sample of Unicode's CollationTest, and which languages, calendars and tailorings (7.17 proposes en, de, fr, it, es, nl; ISO, AD, BE, JE, OS, AH).
